name: Leadboxer API
description:
# LeadBoxer API Documentation

Here you can find the technical documentation needed for using the LeadBoxer API, including the option to generate requests and review the outcomes.

## Getting Started

To get started, please have a look at these pages that include introductions, use-cases, and additional information for the LeadBoxer API: [LeadBoxer API Documentation](https://docs.leadboxer.com/category/112-all)

These documents are intended for LeadBoxer CUSTOMERS that have a valid API license & Key. Please contact us before using the LeadBoxer API.

## Warning

Please be aware that any actions you perform through this reference testing functionality will involve operations with your production data. To test your applications against some sandbox data, we recommend creating a new, separate LeadBoxer account for sandboxing purposes.

This API is under active maintenance, and we are constantly adding new functionality to this version.

[**All requests to the API must be made over SSL (https, not http).**]
